item.title: Why did we wait so long for the bicycle? (2019)
item.description:
📝 Early bicycles were inconvenient and dangerous. City roads at the time were paved with cobblestones, which were good for horses but too bumpy for bicycles. They could deal with all kinds of roads.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.rootsofprogress.org/why-did-we-wait-so-long-for-the-bicycle

item.title: The Myth, the Mythos, and the Man
item.description:
